title: Metagenomic insights into the sewage RNA virosphere of a large city
description: In this study, we used quantitative viral metagenomics to explore the RNA virosphere of wastewater from a treatment plant located in Santiago de Chile, the seventh-largest city in the Americas.
center: Beatriz Diez lab at Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile
samples: Metagenomic insights into the sewage RNA virosphere of a large city
